objective: Productize the data-driven loop-mini configuration schema and pattern composer for objectives, maps, participants/roles, operations, Resources, rules, rewards, limits, difficulty/configuration and declared delivery support, enforcing safe caps and emitting noncanonical configuration until execution/owner commit.
acceptance: One loop-mini configuration contract represents objectives, maps, participants/roles, operations, Resources, rules, rewards, limits, difficulty/configuration and declared delivery support.
The pattern composer validates stable GPR runtime bindings and composes deterministic noncanonical configuration without creating owner-domain truth.
Authoring caps for bounded collections, participant/entity counts and operation/rule/reward complexity fail closed when exceeded.
Unsupported or unresolved registry bindings and unsupported delivery declarations remain explicit and fail closed.
Draft/preview configuration remains noncanonical and cannot prove execution or owner commit.
Composer output is deterministic for semantically equivalent input ordering and remains inspectable/exportable as data.

MRCS is terminal definition authority; GPR-08 composes accepted runtime references and does not reopen MRCS.
Generic creator/debug studio authority remains outside GPR; this tranche implements only the bounded GPR-specific loop-mini schema/composer.
Canonical owner-domain mutation remains execution/receipt-bound; authored configuration is noncanonical.
GPR-09+ delivery/GM controls, presentation, continuity and final proof remain unauthorized.
